The notice came through last week&mdash;some possible malfunction in the guidance systems, I'm told. They're at the Spillwater Fleet base being recalibrated.''"<br />"''Not anymore they're not. ''[&hellip;]'' Nuso Esva is currently loading them aboard his own ships somewhere on Poln Minor.|[[Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Kauf Ularno|Ularno]]|<ref name="Choices" />}}
The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] '''Spillwater Fleet base''',<ref name="Choices" /> built by [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Date1" /> was located in the [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector's]] [[Spillwater system/Legends|Spillwater system]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia" /> In 0 ABY,<ref name="TERC">The events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' take place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]].</ref> the [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruiser]] ''[[Sarissa]]''{{'s}} fifty [[Caldorf VII interceptor missile]]s were removed and sent from Candoras' [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]] to the Spillwater Fleet base, where they would be recalibrated, as their guidance systems were suspected to be malfunctioning; however, the forces of the [[Storm-hair|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] [[Thief/Legends|stole]] the [[Missile/Legends|missiles]] and brought them to Candoras' planet of [[Poln Minor]]. There, his [[Chosen (Nuso Esva)|Chosen]] [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] loaded them aboard his [[Unidentified missile ship|missile ships]].<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Spillwater Fleet base was mentioned in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]''.<ref name="Choices" />
